thread:
sam-fin: Alert from processor: multiple disputes for BrightHire (merchant bhire_llc). 5 chargebacks in last 6 hours, all 'fraudulent' claims. Processor put a temporary reserve and paused payouts.

chargeback-bot: 5 new chargebacks created: cb_309, cb_310, cb_311, cb_312, cb_313. Processor case prefix PROC-BH-9001.

anya-risk: Can we get a quick summary on whether these are same card/last4, IPs, or different patterns? High velocity could be card testing or coerced chargebacks.

joel-bizops: Pulling purchases now. BrightHire says these were part of a promo campaign (30-day trial -> charged). They pushed to a list of users last night.

tara-cs: I pulled the first three disputes. All three cardholders say "I did not authorize this charge". No clear email thread from users requesting a trial cancellation.

sam-fin: Transactions: ```
tx,amount,last4,auth,created_at
trA001,0.00,1111,AUTH900,2025-03-18T22:01:02Z
trA002,19.99,2222,AUTH905,2025-03-18T22:03:10Z
trA003,19.99,3333,AUTH907,2025-03-18T22:05:34Z
trA004,19.99,4444,AUTH908,2025-03-18T22:10:01Z
trA005,19.99,5555,AUTH909,2025-03-18T22:12:44Z
``` Note: first tx trA001 is a zero-authorize that converted to trial charge.

anya-risk: Different last4s and different BINs. IPs: two from same /24, others from distinct geos. Could be a coordinated test or a bad promo list. Need device fingerprints and fraud score.

joel-bizops: BrightHire shared their promo audience csv and the campaign send id. They confirm they used our hosted checkout flow. They have signed TOS acceptance timestamps for 3 of the 5 users.

tara-cs: They also have support logs showing one user opened the app and performed onboarding activities same day as charge for trA002. I'll attach redacted logs to the evidence bucket.

sam-fin: Processor warns if >5 disputes in 24h we may get a rolling reserve or higher fee. BrightHire is asking for immediate release of funds to cover payroll. They offered to pay for representment costs if we pursue.

anya-risk: Representment viability: mixed. We have usage logs for 3 users, signed consent for 3, but 2 have no support activity. For the two unknowns, we should consider partial refunds if representment unlikely. Also need to check whether trial-to-paid notice was sent (email + billing descriptor).

joel-bizops: Billing descriptor for these charges: 'BRIGHTHIR' which matches merchant name but maybe truncated. Email notice sent from billing@brighthireapp.com at 2025-03-18T21:59Z for all five addresses (mailing list bouncebacks?). We need delivery receipts.

sam-fin: Action list: (1) collect device fingerprints & delivery receipts, (2) upload evidence to s3://redwood-evidence/brighthire/1890123456/, (3) recommend representment for 3 tx where strong evidence exists, (4) propose 2 partial refunds to avoid losing entire case and escalation.

anya-risk: Approve representment for trA002, trA004, trA005. Approve up to $20 partial refunds for trA001 and trA003 if bizops requests. Any refunds > $50 require finance lead sign-off.

joel-bizops: BrightHire prefers we attempt representment first. They'll prepare signed user activity export and email headers. I'll coordinate.

tara-cs: Uploaded redacted activity logs and outbound email headers to s3://redwood-evidence/brighthire/1890123456/. DM'd link to anya and sam.

chargeback-bot: Representment packets created for cb_310, cb_312, cb_313. Status: submitted.

sam-fin: Noted. Joe/Joel, if processor holds escalate to reserves, we should prepare liquidity plan. Also logging FIN-TICKET-5499 to track merchant balance and potential write-offs.

anya-risk: I'll monitor processor response. If representment denied for any of the three, we will advise immediate partial refunds for the two borderline ones to reduce merchant risk and processor relationship damage.

joel-bizops: BrightHire asked about how chargeback fees will be applied. Sam, can you confirm fee schedule and whether we can waive one-time fee as a gesture?

sam-fin: Fee schedule: $15 chargeback fee + potential retrieval fee. We can waive one fee once with approval. I'll put approval request in FIN-5499.

anya-risk: Thanks team. Keep updates here. If we see >2 more disputes in next 12h, escalate to payments director.
